limitations: All financial paths are forward expected-use simulations. No revenue, cash transfer, provider invoice, paid API job or contract execution was observed.

Demand, prices, collection, refunds, rejection probabilities, construction success, savings and human workflow times are assumptions. Arithmetic agreement does not establish their likelihood.
Capacity and payback forecasts are aggregate expected-use resource ceilings, not validated daily schedules, stochastic budget guarantees, token quotas or cash-feasible future production guarantees.
Every paid construction attempt, failed candidate and incurred upkeep is charged. Simulated promotions and assumed diminishing gains are not observed invention or self-acceleration.

Customer savings, invoices, collected revenue, accounting income, taxes, reserves, idle earmarks, actual cash and usable reinvestment resources remain distinct. Final receivables do not fund spending.
Unknown historical authoring, material downstream liability and high-consequence work remain outside validated scope; they have not been silently assigned zero.

Source-based token arithmetic does not verify deployment state, contract behavior on-chain, legal rights, liquidity or market price. Fee-wallet receipts and returned collateral are not worker enterprise profits; Jobs-v0 failure economics and failure-route gas remain unmodeled.
